title: feat(rest,metadata-protocol,spec): the per-item publish takes a draft-version pin, so Save to this view never publishes a moved draft
body:
Fixes #36350

Clause-②: yes (widening)
Metadata-protocol: added
Skills-docs: none — `skills/**` teaches no per-item metadata publish request: 0 hits over `skills/` for a `/meta/…/publish` route, `PublishMetaItem`, `publishMetaItem`, `draftVersion` or `parentVersion` (the one `If-Match` hit is the data `PATCH` route's optimistic lock).

## 维护者速读

- 用户能看到什么变化：管理员点「保存到此视图」时，若另一位管理员恰好在同一视图上改名、置顶或设为默认，这次发布会被拒绝，别人尚未审过的草稿不会被顺带发布；草稿栏的「发布」也只发布它显示的那份草稿。
- 为什么做：维护者已裁定「别人尚未发布的草稿绝不替他发布」，此前实测这个空窗仍可复现，本次按维护者选定的方案在发布入口统一加草稿版本校验。
- 出错会怎样：最坏情况是本应成功的保存或发布被误拒并提示冲突，草稿原样保留、不丢数据；「保存到此视图」可直接再存一次，草稿栏的「发布」需重新打开视图设置、看过最新草稿后再发布；改动可整体撤回。
- 要你做什么：无。

## What changes

Ruling 7168616260 (A1) on #36350, executed as ruled:

- **Spec** — `PublishMetaItemRequestSchema` gains one optional member, `draftVersion`: the version token of the draft the caller wrote or read and means to publish; its describe says the draft is judged first and that an address refusal (`404 NO_DRAFT`) precedes both pins. `parentVersion` (`If-Match`) keeps its shipped meaning, the active row's token; its describe now points at the draft's own pin. `MetadataConflictErrorSchema` names the draft pin: on the publish door a refused `draftVersion` returns the draft's token, sent back as `draftVersion`, never as `If-Match`, and `null` there means nothing is pending to publish. The publish route's declaration in `plugin-rest-api.zod.ts` lists the 409 causes, both body read keys and the new 400. Generated reference (`content/docs/references/api/protocol.mdx`) and `authorable-surface/api.json` regenerated by the build / `check:generated --fix`.
- **Protocol** (`packages/metadata-protocol/src/protocol-history-and-publish.ts`) — `promoteDraftForPublish` judges `draftVersion` against the draft row it just read, before any authoring rule judges that draft, with the save door's keyed comparison (`storedParentForToken`). A moved draft, or a pinned draft no longer pending, is refused `409 METADATA_CONFLICT` with `currentVersion` = the draft's current token (`null` when none), nothing promoted, and the same optimistic-conflict audit row as the other publish conflicts. An off-type `draftVersion` from an in-process caller is refused `400 VALIDATION_ERROR`, never read as unpinned. `PublishMetaItemRequest` (`protocol-door-requests.ts`, the public `publishMetaItem` type) now declares `draftVersion` and `parentVersion`. The existing `expectedDraftHash` keeps the promotion locked to that row through the write. The conflict-to-refusal mapping moved into one local helper shared by the pin and the promotion's own `catch` (same text and audit as before for the existing two conflicts).
- **REST door** (`packages/rest/src/meta-item-history-routes.ts`) — `POST /meta/:type/:name/publish` reads `draftVersion` from its body beside `message` and forwards it when present; a present non-string is refused `400 VALIDATION_ERROR`, never read as absent.
- **Client** (`ui/packages/data-objectstack`) — `MetadataClient.publish` takes `draftVersion` and sends it in the body. `ObjectStackAdapter.updateView`'s draft branch reads the draft through `getDraft` (the envelope carries `version`) BEFORE the layered read it merges from, and writes pinned to it (`If-Match`, or `If-None-Match: *` when the read saw no draft).
- **Console** (`ui/packages/app-shell/src/views/`) — "Save to this view" (`saveAndPublishRuntimeMetadata`) passes the version its own draft write returned; a moved draft's `409` resolves `'pending-draft'` and the moved draft is NOT discarded (it now holds the other writer's change); a `409` with `currentVersion: null` (the draft was published or discarded by someone else) rethrows, since there is no draft to review. The runtime draft bar's Publish (`publishRuntimeMetadata`) passes the draft token the bar shows: on open, the one its draft read (`readRuntimeDraftForPublish`, through `getDraft`) returned; after its host's own save, that save's receipt version, which the view settings panel hands it as `savedDraftVersion` from its draft-version guard (`useDraftSaveGuard().heldDraftVersion`). Never a blind re-read.

Absent `draftVersion` is unpinned everywhere, as before.

## Why

Measured on main before any code (report 7164597391, re-run on the merged tree here): "Save to this view"'s draft write, then an `updateView`-style draft write, then the publish pinned with the only pin main offered (`If-Match` on the active row) answered 200 and published the interleaved draft. Ruling 7058616478 (#35955): an unpublished draft is never published on someone else's behalf.

## Tests

- Acceptance pin, in the publish door's existing harness `packages/rest/src/meta-item-publish-version-pin.test.ts` (new top-level describe, ruling record 6583487846), real stack at the HTTP door:
  - an `updateView` draft write (pinned, and unpinned) interleaved between Save's draft write and its publish: refused `409 METADATA_CONFLICT`, `currentVersion` = the moved draft's token (parsed by `MetadataConflictErrorSchema`), active row unchanged, moved draft still pending;
  - control: no interleave, the pinned publish promotes; absent member: unpinned as before; pinned draft no longer pending: `409`, `currentVersion: null`; a draft token sent as `If-Match` still answers the active row's refusal; non-string `draftVersion` (number, null, object): `400 VALIDATION_ERROR`, nothing promoted; in process, an off-type `draftVersion` is refused `400` by the protocol; the acceptance refusal writes one `publish` / `denied` `metadata_conflict` audit row.
- The measurement file `meta-item-publish-draft-interleave-36350.test.ts` is removed: its M1 is now the acceptance pin above; M0 (token identity) is asserted there (`readDraft().version` equals the receipt and the refusal's `currentVersion`); M2 and M3 measured options B-extended and C, which the ruling did not take, and their readings stay recorded in report 7164597391.
- Spec: `protocol.test.ts` pins `draftVersion` preserved through parse, absent stays absent, non-strings refused.
- Client / console: `updateView.draft.test.ts` (new describe: `If-Match` from the draft read, read before the layers; `If-None-Match: *` when the read saw none; a `409` reaches the caller; no version pins nothing), `metadata-client.publishPackageBinding.test.ts` (body carries `draftVersion` beside `message`; omitted, no key), `runtime-metadata-persistence.test.ts` (Save passes its receipt's version; a moved draft resolves `pending-draft` and is not discarded; `currentVersion: null` rethrows; draft bar passes the shown token), `RuntimeDraftBar.test.tsx` (Publish sends the shown version; refusal keeps the bar; after the host's own save the Publish is pinned to that save's receipt version with no re-read; the save-then-publish window refuses another writer's draft; a host with no receipt version stays unpinned), `ViewConfigPanel.pinnedDraftSave-36137.test.tsx` (each landed save hands the bar its own receipt version). Four existing draft-bar / `updateView` doubles now answer `getDraft` and the drafts ledger.

The full `packages/app-shell/` suite was not re-run this round; `Test UI` carries it.

## Acceptance notes

- Where the draft pin is judged: right after the promotion's draft read, before the authoring rules judge that draft, so a moved draft answers the conflict rather than a rule refusal about someone else's body. The active-row pin (`parentVersion`) is still judged where #36601 put it, inside the promotion.
- "Save to this view" on a moved draft resolves `'pending-draft'` (the same answer as over a draft found pending before its write) and leaves the draft for review. That draft holds this save's body with the other writer's change on top; it is not discarded because it is no longer this call's own.
- `updateView` now reads its draft sequentially (`getDraft`, then `/layers`) instead of in parallel, one extra round trip, so a pin can only be older than the body it merges, never newer.
- The draft bar, after its host's own save (`savedSignal`, which the view settings panel bumps on every landed save), pins its Publish to that save's receipt version (`savedDraftVersion`). A host that gives no receipt version leaves that Publish unpinned, as before.
- After a refused Publish the bar keeps the token it showed, so a second press is refused again until the author reopens the view settings and sees the current draft. That is the safe direction: the bar never re-pins itself to a draft it did not show.
- Out of scope, carried by the seat to a close-out card: eight other draft-then-publish call sites in six files send no `draftVersion` yet (`studio-design/studioSaveBar.tsx` twice, `metadata-admin/DraftConflictDialog.tsx`, `metadata-admin/detailSaveAtOnce.ts`, `recordTabsConfigSave.ts`, `objectExtensionArrangementSave.ts`, `layout/designModeMenuSave.ts` twice), and `@objectstack/client`'s `publishItem` can state neither pin. The member is opt-in by ruling; ruling item 3 named the four callers this PR pins.
- Contract-review-tier L2: recorded FAIL on 8eee7080 (7179921339); this head answers M1, M2, S1–S3 and N1–N5.
